rows.en: As part of training,\nfight a mock battle against Gamlin.
Danger always lurks on a journey through vast space. To prepare for the worst,\ndefeat Diamond Force member Lt. Gamlin Kizaki in a training mock battle.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'the vastness of space' -> 'vast space'; 'emergencies' -> 'the worst' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Recover the containers holding citizens\nand annihilate the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'the citizens' -> 'citizens'

rows.en: Citizens kidnapped by the Varauta Army are being carried off in containers.\nAnnihilate the Varauta escort and bring the containers to the designated area.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Varauta forces transporting the containers' -> 'Varauta escort'

rows.en: Retake the fold generator, then defend\nit and annihilate the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: fold generator: term not in glossary. | review: term added to glossary

rows.en: The Varauta Army is trying to re-fold City 7, now cut off from Battle 7.\nRetake the generator, annihilate the Varauta Army and stop the re-fold.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'which has been cut off' -> 'now cut off'

rows.en: Protect as many civilian craft as possible\nwhile annihilating the Varauta Army.
The Varauta Army suddenly appeared during the crowded Battroid Carnival.\nKeep citizens safe: guard the Monsters while annihilating the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: Battroid Carnival not in glossary. 'Monster' (the Destroid) number unclear; plural chosen to match 'civilian craft' in objective row 410. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: 'where crowds of citizens had gathered' -> 'crowded'; restructured purpose clause

rows.en: To protect the citizens of City 7,\nannihilate the Varauta Army.
Battle 7's relief escorts were wiped out instantly by a mysterious Varauta foe.\nAnnihilate the Varauta Army to protect the citizens of City 7.
rows.notes: JP break falls mid-word near the end of sentence 1; moved to the sentence boundary. | review: refit: 'escort ships sent from Battle 7 to help' -> 'Battle 7's relief escorts'

rows.en: Annihilate the Varauta Army that is\nblocking the escape from the blazing star.
rows.notes: review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Just as City 7 is dragged toward a blazing star, the Varauta Army attacks.\nAnnihilate the Varauta Army at once and escape from the star.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'has chosen this crisis to attack' folded into 'Just as... attacks'

rows.en: Annihilate the Varauta Army, which has\nlaunched a large-scale attack.
Varauta forces struck suddenly near Lux. Macross 7 faces its worst crisis yet.\nSink the Varauta flagship to break their chain of command and end this crisis.

rows.en: Destroy the Protodeviln,\nor survive for 5 minutes.
Detected: a likely Protodeviln, approx. 300 m long, unlike any enemy so far.\nMake survival your top priority, and destroy the Protodeviln if possible.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'enemy contact believed to be' -> 'likely'; 'clearly unlike' -> 'unlike' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Stop the Protodeviln coming to save their\ncomrade from reaching the target area.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'rescue' -> 'save'

rows.en: We captured a Protodeviln, but let its would-be rescuers break into Battle 7.\nAnnihilate the intruders and stop them from seizing the Protodeviln.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'the enemy coming to rescue it' -> 'its would-be rescuers'; 'the enemy inside Battle 7' -> 'the intruders'

rows.en: Annihilate the Varauta Army.
The Protodeviln have begun a full-scale attack on the Macross 7 fleet.\nWe cannot fall to the Protodeviln here. Annihilate the Varauta Army.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: As part of training,\nfight a mock battle with the legendary duo.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'against' -> 'with'

rows.en: Commencing a mock battle to prepare for the escalating Protodeviln war.\nDefeat the married duo: a genius pilot of old in the latest VF, and an ex-ace.
rows.notes: Duo is Max and Milia (not named in JP). JP 'riding the newest machine' may modify only the genius pilot; rendered as applying to both. | review: source has only the genius pilot in the latest machine; 'both' was added | review: refit: 'husband-and-wife' -> 'married'; 'of years past' -> 'of old'; 'machine' -> 'model'; 'former ace' -> 'ex-ace' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Annihilate the Varauta Army to carry\nout Operation Stargazer.
Commencing Operation Stargazer, a surprise assault by a small elite force.\nEliminate the Varauta Army at all costs to fire reaction weapons into the cave.
rows.notes: review: refit: dropped quote marks; 'target cave' -> 'the cave'; 'Annihilate' -> 'Wipe out' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Shoot down Gamlin, who is being\ncontrolled by the Protodeviln.
rows.notes: Objective verb is destroy/defeat; 'shoot down' matches the story row's authorization.

rows.en: Capt. Gamlin, possessed by the Protodeviln, is on a rampage, wrecking bases.\nFurther damage is unacceptable. You are authorized to shoot down Capt. Gamlin.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'military facilities' -> 'bases'; Captain -> Capt. | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: To protect the peace of the galaxy,\ndestroy Gepelnitchi.

rows.notes: review: refit: 'the peace of the galaxy' -> 'galactic peace'

rows.notes: JP writes the short form 'Meltran' + 'stray' fleet; rendered 'rogue Meltrandi fleet' after the glossary's 'Queadluun-Rau (Rogue)'. | review: term added to glossary

rows.en: A vanguard ship has been destroyed by a large rogue Meltrandi fleet.\nThey must come no closer to the Macross 7 fleet. Annihilate the rogue fleet.
rows.notes: JP break falls mid-sentence; moved to the sentence boundary. Same rogue-fleet term as row 442. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: 'We can't let them' -> 'They mustn't' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Harvest Spiritia from the fleet where\na Spiritia reaction was detected.
rows.notes: Protodeviln-side mission (MD_*), villain voice.

rows.en: Reviving our master, Lord Gepelnitchi, requires a vast amount of Spiritia.\nAttack the fleet showing a massive Spiritia reaction and harvest its Spiritia.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured; 'where... was detected' -> 'showing'

rows.en: For Lord Gepelnitchi's plan,\nannihilate the wretched samples.
rows.notes: 'Samples' = Protodeviln contempt word for humans, with a contemptuous plural suffix; not in glossary. | review: term added to glossary

rows.en: To make Lord Gepelnitchi's dream, the "Spiritia Farm Project," a reality,\nwe now begin our attack on the samples' flagship. Annihilate the samples.
Annihilate the samples who have\nlaunched a surprise attack.
The fools! The samples have launched a surprise attack on our Varauta system.\nShow them that resistance is futile. Annihilate the samples at once.
Fight alongside Lord Gepelnitchi and\nannihilate those Anima Spiritia.
The Anima Spiritia's power has at last revived Lord Gepelnitchi's true body.\nFight beside the mighty Lord Gepelnitchi and annihilate those Anima Spiritia.
rows.notes: review: refit: active voice; 'fearsomely powerful' -> 'mighty'

rows.en: Arrest the poachers\ntargeting the Galaxy Whales.
rows.notes: review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Galaxy Whales are nearing orbit; we've detected likely poachers hunting them.\nArrest them once confirmed. You may ignore the civilian craft also spotted.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'confirmed as poachers' -> 'confirmed'; merged civilian-craft clause

When the Galaxy Whales near Zola, poachers flock to the planet in droves.\nTo prepare, the Zolan Star Patrol holds its regular training: a mock battle.
rows.notes: review: refit: tighter wording

rows.en: Arrest the poachers\ntargeting the Galaxy Whales.
rows.notes: review: briefing register pass (same text as row 452)

rows.notes: review: refit: 'turn a blind eye to' -> 'ignore' | review: briefing register pass

rows.en: Escort Officer Liza to the target area\nand arrest the poachers.
Undercover with the poachers, Officer Liza is trying to flee in a stolen VF-17.\nEscort her to the target area, then arrest the poachers and black marketeers.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Once she is safe, move on to' -> 'then'

rows.en: Protect the Galaxy Whale from the\nreaction weapon and arrest the poachers.
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Poachers aim a reaction weapon at the white Galaxy Whale hampering their hunt.\nProtect the whale from the weapon at all costs and arrest the poachers.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'plan to use... to get rid of' -> 'aim... at'; second mentions shortened

rows.notes: review: refit: 'ring out across' -> 'ring across'
